subject: URGENT: FAST-NU Alumni Need-Based Higher Education Scholarship 2026
body:
Dear Students,

The FAST Alumni Association is pleased to announce the 2026 Spring Need-Based Merit Scholarship. Eligible undergraduate students facing financial constraints can receive full tuition coverage for the upcoming academic year.

Eligibility:
- Open to all engineering, CS, and business programs.
- Current CGPA of 3.00 or above.
- Demonstrated financial need.

Required Documents:
1. Latest Salary Slip / Income Certificate of guardian.
2. Official University Academic Transcript.
3. Handwritten Statement of Purpose explaining financial background.
4. Copy of CNIC / Student ID.

Deadline to apply: March 3, 2026 (strictly 11:59 PM PST).
Apply online at: https://portal.nu.edu.pk/alumni-scholarship-2026
Queries to: finaid-lahore@nu.edu.pk

subject: Google Summer of Code (GSoC) 2026 Contributor Applications Now Open!
body:
Hi Developers,

Google Summer of Code (GSoC) 2026 is officially open for student developer applications! Spend your summer contributing to open source organizations under the mentorship of senior engineers.

Highlights:
- Flexible 12-week or 22-week projects.
- Global stipend ($1,500 - $3,000 USD based on location).
- Eligibility: Enrolled post-secondary student (Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science or related technical discipline).
- Skills needed: Python, C++, JavaScript, Rust, Git.

Required for Application:
- Project Proposal following mentoring org template.
- Proof of student enrollment.
- GitHub profile / portfolio link.

Application Deadline: March 15, 2026.
Official portal: https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com
For questions check the FAQ on the official site.

subject: Call for Applications: MIT-Harvard Robotics & Vision Research Fellowship (Summer 2026)
body:
Dear CS & Robotics Students,

The CSAIL Vision & Robotics Lab invites exceptional 3rd and 4th-year undergraduate researchers to apply for the fully funded 10-week Summer Research Fellowship in Cambridge, MA.

Candidate Requirements:
- Minimum CGPA of 3.75 / 4.00 (Strictly enforced).
- Major in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or Electrical Engineering (Semester 5 to 8).
- Strong foundation in Deep Learning, PyTorch, ROS, or Computer Vision.

Benefits:
- Full travel stipend, on-campus housing, and $5,000 research grant.

Application Checklist:
1. Detailed Academic CV.
2. Statement of Research Purpose (max 2 pages).
3. Two Letters of Recommendation from university faculty.
4. Official Transcript.

Deadline: March 25, 2026.
Application link: https://csail.mit.edu/fellowships/summer-2026-vision

subject: SOFTEC 2026 — All-Pakistan National AI & Software Hackathon
body:
Calling all innovators and builders!

SOFTEC 2026 is Pakistan's largest student technology extravaganza. Registrations are open for the AI Hackathon, Web App Dev, and Speed Programming competitions.

Details:
- Open to all enrolled university students from any semester or degree.
- Team size: 2 to 4 members.
- Cash prizes exceeding PKR 1,000,000, trophy, and networking with top tech recruiters.

Requirements:
- Team Lead Student ID Card.
- Project Abstract / Tech Stack pitch.

Registration closes on: March 8, 2026.
Register your team at: https://softecnu.org/register
Contact: registrations@softecnu.org

subject: McKinsey & Company — Summer Business Analyst Internship 2026
body:
Dear Students,

McKinsey & Company is hiring Summer Business Analysts for our Middle East & Pakistan offices. Join our teams to solve challenging strategic business problems for top organizations.

Eligibility:
- Bachelor's students in Business Administration (BBA), Economics, Finance, or Accounting.
- Minimum CGPA 3.30.
- Penultimate year students (Semesters 5-6).

Requirements:
- 1-page Consulting Resume.
- Cover Letter.
- University Transcripts.

Application Deadline: March 12, 2026.
Submit your application at: https://www.mckinsey.com/careers/students/business-analyst
Direct inquiries to: recruiting-pk@mckinsey.com

subject: Devsinc Machine Learning Engineer Associate (Summer 2026 Internship)
body:
Devsinc is looking for ambitious Machine Learning / Python Interns to join our Lahore AI Hub this summer.

Job Highlights:
- Paid 3-month internship with pre-placement job offer for top performers (PKR 60,000/mo stipend).
- Eligibility: BS Computer Science, BS Software Engineering, BS Data Science (6th to 8th Semester).
- Minimum CGPA: 3.00.
- Skills: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch or TensorFlow, SQL, Docker basics.

Documents Needed:
- Resume containing links to GitHub / Kaggle projects.
- Unofficial Transcript.

Deadline: March 5, 2026.
Apply here: https://careers.devsinc.com/jobs/ml-intern-2026

subject: Goldman Sachs Global Virtual Insights Series & Mentorship Program
body:
Discover what it's like to work at Goldman Sachs. We invite undergraduate students across Computer Science, Data Engineering, and Finance to join our 4-week interactive virtual insights masterclass series.

Eligibility:
- All undergraduate students (1st to 8th semester).
- No minimum CGPA requirement.
- Passion for FinTech, quantitative finance, or cloud infrastructure.

Benefits:
- Direct mentorship from GS Managing Directors, Certificate of Completion, fast-track interview invite for 2027 graduate roles.

Deadline: March 20, 2026.
Register online: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/students/programs/virtual-series
